findings.reproduction: Run owned acceptance_artifacts.py. Genuinely train/evaluate at threshold 0.5, change only ModelVersion.threshold to 0.0, then request gate/activation. Inspect threshold_binding, missing_input_bytes and extended_raw_outputs.
findings.expected: Metrics bind the complete decision rule and available input bytes. Invalid raw predictions revoke previous eligibility through a bounded response.
findings.actual: The changed threshold activates using cached F1=1.0; genuine reevaluation computes F1=0.6667, below the 0.75 gate. Removing a held-out image also leaves activation eligible. Mixed boolean/numeric predictions are accepted; ragged predictions or ValueError return 500 and preserve the passing gate. Persisted F1=10**400 also returns 500.
findings.fix: Bind evaluated, registry and artifact thresholds and complete provenance; reject missing input bytes. Validate raw elements before conversion, normalize prediction failures, invalidate metrics on every failed evaluation, and make metric validation overflow-safe.

findings.reproduction: Run owned acceptance_artifacts.py. After simulated activation of a genuine CPU Student, inspect active_metadata_empty/missing_dataset/missing_encoder, active_weights_tampered and active_same_dataset_v2_archive.
findings.expected: Active classification requires complete provenance and the exact approved artifact identity. Invalid artifacts return a bounded non-Student result without changing the pointer.
findings.actual: Classify passes require_complete=False: real archives with empty or missing provenance still return Student predictions. Replaced weights continue classifying while the gate fails. Pointing v1 at a genuine v2 archive with matching dataset metadata reports version=1 despite different artifact hashes.
findings.fix: Require complete verified loading and approved artifact-hash verification for classification. Check runtime encoder/preprocessing/threshold identity, remove production fixture exemptions, and return unavailable/unknown or bounded fallback on mismatch.

findings.reproduction: Run owned new_user_activation.py. Create positive_label=damaged and negative_label=undamaged, import/review five independent QA_ONLY sessions, train, then request activation, shadow and evaluation. Compare occupied/empty.
findings.expected: Supported distinct labels preserve negative=0 and positive=1 through training, registry, save/reload and approval.
findings.actual: Training returns 200/F1=1.0 and gate passes, but registry metadata maps damaged=0, undamaged=1 while saved classes are [undamaged, damaged]. Immediate activation rejects class_ordering; shadow returns 422 and reevaluation fails. Reversed empty/occupied also fails; occupied/empty succeeds.
findings.fix: Construct {negative_label:0, positive_label:1} before version reservation/save and use it consistently. Preserve the class-order integrity check, test positive-sorts-first labels, and regenerate affected artifacts honestly.

findings.reproduction: Run owned acceptance_transport.py and preflight_retry.py. Label with a malformed HTTP port/control-character URL, correct it and retry. Separately corrupt cached confidence/model/image_hash and repeat fallback.
findings.expected: Known local failures send zero POSTs, consume zero budget and remain recoverable. Cache reuse requires strict confidence and complete matching provenance.
findings.actual: Malformed HTTP URLs send zero POSTs but return 500, leave a reserved budget row and no initial audit. Correcting the URL still dedupes the pending sample with budget_remaining=0. Cache rows with confidence=None, unrelated model or wrong image_hash return cache_hit/occupied. Unreadable replaced stored image bytes are sent under the old hash.
findings.fix: Preflight the actual HTTP URL/port, configuration and image decode/content hash before send-state. Release known zero-send failures with an audit; retain uncertain actual spend. Strictly validate complete cached confidence and identity on every reuse path.

findings.reproduction: Run owned boundary_probes.py and acceptance_transport.py with their TCP fixture mirroring the supplied read-only local_teacher.py envelope. Inspect actual_local_scoring, fallback_scoring_provenance and scoring_validation.
findings.expected: The actual scoring contract is validated and durably traceable through samples, audits, fallback and cache, including candidate tokens/log likelihoods, probabilities, revision and work counts.
findings.actual: Sample metadata correctly retains candidate_sequence_softmax, explicit revision, forwards, processed tokens and generated-json=false, but drops candidate_token_ids and candidate_log_likelihoods. Fallback loses revision/scores/work counts; its cache lacks complete provenance. Probabilities [2,-1], unrelated labels and unequal arrays are persisted as candidate scores.
findings.fix: Validate aligned, bounded scoring fields and normalized probabilities. Persist complete provenance once and reference it from samples, attempt audits and fallback/cache reuse. Reject or explicitly flag malformed scoring without inventing generated-JSON provenance.

findings.reproduction: Run owned ui_delayed_create.cjs against the actual transpiled page. Start enabled Create on A, select enabled B while the POST is delayed, then complete creation of C.
findings.expected: Late completion releases its busy ownership without replacing the newer task selection or errors.
findings.actual: Before completion selected/detail=2 (B); afterward selected/detail=3 (C). Create ignores RunCtx and unconditionally selects the returned task after awaits. Ordinary Create and all 20 expanded task-operation success/error navigation cases correctly recover controls.
findings.fix: Give Create a RunCtx and guard post-await form/selection changes and operation-owned refresh errors with ctx.live(). Preserve independent opGen busy cleanup.
